earth_applications.title: Spacecraft-Derived Fire Detector Technology
earth_applications.description: Sensors engineered to distinguish true smoke particulates from nuisance cabin dust and moisture in microgravity have informed advanced multi-criteria building and industrial particulate fire alarms on Earth.

provenance.note: NASA Spinoff publication on aerosol detection systems

earth_applications.title: Firefighter Composite Breathing Air Tanks
earth_applications.description: Lightweight structural composite pressure vessel technology originally designed for spacecraft life support and combustion chambers was transferred to firefighter self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA), reducing tank weight by over 30 percent.

provenance.note: NASA Johnson Space Center commercial tech transfer report

earth_applications.title: Firefighter Flame-Resistant Protective Clothing
earth_applications.description: High-temperature polymer fabrics (PBI, Nomex) developed and evaluated under NASA space suit and flammability testing programs form the outer shell and thermal liners of modern firefighter bunker gear.

provenance.note: NASA Glenn Research Center thermal protective materials assessment

earth_applications.title: Fine Water Mist Fire Suppression
earth_applications.description: Research on droplet extinction dynamics (such as FLEX and MDCA) revealed the high thermal suppression efficiency of microscopic water mists, replacing ozone-depleting halon systems in marine and industrial facilities.

provenance.note: Combustion Integrated Rack droplet suppression science brief

nasa_combustion_science.title: NASA Combustion Science Program
nasa_combustion_science.description: Official overview of NASA Biological and Physical Sciences combustion research in microgravity.

researchers_guide_2015.title: Researcher's Guide to ISS Combustion Science (2015)
researchers_guide_2015.description: NASA Johnson Space Center guide NP-2015-03-014-JSC on ISS combustion facilities, diagnostics, and test matrices.

psi_repository.title: NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI)
psi_repository.description: Open-access repository for physical science experiment data from the ISS and flight platforms.
